exposure: previous diagnosis of urinary tract infection
cohort: 319 puerperal women in a public institution in which the maternity department is a reference for high risk care.
finding: Primiparity, previous diagnosis of hypertension, preeclampsia, and urinary tract infection, as well as the use of certain health technologies (transportation for hospitalization, amniotic fluid assessment, vital signs monitoring, partograph use, and user satisfaction) were associated with maternal near-miss in labor and delivery.
